variants.optimizerInput: Skate Rack, Room Decor, Tier 3, Garden Glow. Create ONE compact freestanding roller-skate storage rack with two sturdy botanical-green side frames, warm-oak base and exactly three open storage bays. Place ONE unmistakable matching pair of quad roller skates in the lower two bays: each boot must show a clear boot upper, trucks and four large wheels. Leave the upper bay empty so rack geometry dominates. Add one tiny leaf cutout only. Plain studio background, grounded shadow. NO planter, NO grass shelf, NO skateboard, NO loose floor skates, NO duplicate rack, NO text.

Skate Rack, Room Decor, Tier 3, Garden Glow. Design ONE simple A-frame skate organizer with a wide base, three shelves/bays and one clearly formed pair of quad skates contained inside one bay. Keep the rack silhouette dominant, with readable wheels and supports. NO plants covering the top, NO board shapes, NO multiple racks, NO room scene, NO text.

Dream Vanity Set, Room Decor, Tier 4, Art Attack. Create EXACTLY ONE coherent vanity set in one view: one compact vanity table with two drawer stacks, one large attached oval mirror, one matching stool placed in front, and two small bounded organizer cups on the tabletop. Use cream, lavender, coral and aqua Art Attack accents with believable wood/painted-metal/mirror materials. Full set isolated on plain studio background with grounded shadows. NO collage, NO multiple panels, NO alternate vanities, NO split-screen, NO room scene, NO text.

Dream Vanity Set, Room Decor, Tier 4, Art Attack. Design ONE freestanding vanity table with attached mirror, integrated drawers and one stool, all matching as a single set. Add restrained painterly color accents but keep furniture construction dominant. NO comparison views, NO repeated furniture, NO collage, NO text.

Trophy Wall, Room Decor, Tier 5, Star Luxe. Create ONE premium wall-mounted trophy display: dark midnight-blue backboard with brushed-gold frame, one shallow attached display shelf, EXACTLY THREE unmistakable trophy cups of different sizes plus two hanging medal ribbons, all physically mounted and clearly visible. Add restrained star-shaped gold inlays and tiny crystal accents. Three-quarter wall view with real backboard thickness/standoffs and cast shadow. NO abstract mosaic, NO repeated star pattern as the main object, NO room scene, NO text/logos.

Trophy Wall, Room Decor, Tier 5, Star Luxe. Design ONE wall-hung trophy shelf/backboard with clear gold cups, medals and one central star award arranged on a dark premium panel. The trophies must dominate the silhouette and remain readable at card size. NO abstract relief-only composition, NO geometric star wallpaper, NO collage, NO text.
